finding.headline: "Coordinating the Househelp / Nanny Without Drama"
finding.problem: "I have a helper but I'm still the manager of everything. She doesn't know the baby's schedule, the kids fight her. I'm more stressed with help than without."
finding.person: Mum who employs a nanny/househelp (common in Nigeria) but can't coordinate shifts, meals, the baby — resentment & confusion (Banany, 2026).
finding.competition_notes: See RESEARCH BASE section of source report.

disposition.rationale: Report assigns: "Standalone product (househelp coordination system) — Nigeria-specific, low competition". Verdict: PASSES (3/5).
